goal: Convert GSC demand signals into a repeatable action queue that favors strengthening existing URLs and Device Passport data before creating new URLs.

input_state.policy: Do not fabricate 2026-09-19 GSC metrics. Use the dated seed only until a newer raw export is supplied.

initial_result.note: The two top Phase128 net-new candidates now have dedicated URLs in main, so they are reclassified to strengthen_existing.

decision_rules: Existing intent-matched URLs are strengthened rather than duplicated.
Exact Query×Page exports outrank inferred query-to-page mapping.
Missing metrics remain null and are not imputed.
Qualitative demand does not enter exact numeric ranking.
URL creation requires distinct intent, insufficient existing coverage and available evidence.
next_execution: Use the next raw SolQvia GSC export to replace the dated seed.
Strengthen the highest-priority existing URL first.
Feed device/carrier/SIM/eSIM demand into Device Passport enrichment where the query exposes a data gap.
Only create a new URL when no existing page cleanly satisfies the intent.
qa_targets: No new public URL is introduced by Phase145.
All unavailable GSC values remain null or explicitly lower-bound/approximate.
